messages:
rachel: Quick manager checklist for the new infra PM starting Mon. Keeping it lean so it's copy/paste ready.

rachel: Pre-start: confirm device + charger, Okta group, GitHub invite, Slack channels, Confluence page, assign buddy.

diego: I'll handle Okta and GitHub invites today. Any vendor SSO needed?

vlada: FYI we should delay elevated cloud roles until Day10 unless blocked. Adds friction otherwise.

infra-bot: Device RD-33011: delivery Tue 11am PT. GitHub invite sent. See https://redwood.internal/onboard/33011

rachel: Day1 AM schedule (paste into calendar): 30m manager 1:1 (welcome + expectations), 30m team intro, 15m buddy intro, 30m product context. Day1 PM: environment smoke test with buddy.

rachel: Days 2-5: two stakeholder 1:1s (eng lead, analytics), small scoped task to ship, reading list (top RFCs + 3 customer tickets). Day5: review 30/60/90 draft and set three concrete 30-day outcomes.

diego: Can you share a compact outcome-based 30/60/90? I prefer measurable bullets.

rachel: Sure — compact example: 30d: access + summary of 3 customers + quick win merged. 60d: lead a small experiment with specs + metrics. 90d: own a roadmap slice and show impact via before/after metric.

vlada: Where do we publish drafts? Confluence team space after manager review. Keep private draft until then.

recruiter-bot: Reminder: please confirm first-week schedule with new hire and cc recruiting for feedback.

rachel: Thanks all 64f. I'll post a one-line Confluence milestone after manager review and set Day2/Day5 check-ins. Ping here if any access stalls.
